name: Pinterest
one_liner: Pinterest API v5 for building apps for creators, advertisers, and merchants (pins, boards, ads, catalogs, analytics).
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow with access token and refresh; exact redirect URI matching. Trial-approved apps can generate test tokens (24h expiry) without the OAuth flow.
access_notes: Business account required. Trial access request is reviewed by Pinterest; Standard access needs a second review with a demo video of the OAuth flow. Trial: 1000 requests/day per app and pins/boards visible only to creator. Free, no cost stated.

buildability.rationale: Standard OAuth2, documented API with sandbox and test tokens, but every app needs Pinterest review for Trial and a second video-demo review for Standard (production) access.

auth.quote: Exchange the authorization code for an access token

access.quote: Application requests are reviewed by Pinterest.
Prepare a video recording of your app completing an action using the Pinterest API.

sandbox.quote: all Pins and Boards created with Trial access are only visible to their creator as Sandbox entities.

api_surface.quote: Trial access: 1000 requests per day for all API requests
Our SDK currently offers a Python library that supports campaign management

buildability.quote: If you want to offer Pinterest capabilities to your users, we recommend upgrading to Standard access

identity.quote: The Pinterest API allows developers to build experiences and apps for creators, advertisers, and merchants.
